scope: Prompt S6 - Offline-safe operation, financial settlement blocking, user-partitioned IndexedDB queue, authenticated replay with IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH detection, connectivity states, and payment loss reconciliation.

gateEvidence.canonicalTestSuitePassed: Master test runner exit 0: 46/46 suites, 391 tests passing cleanly.
gateEvidence.zeroSettledOfflineFinancialInvariant: Payment capture/settlement, refunds, voids, drawer ops, payroll, and EOD closings are strictly blocked offline and rejected in batch sync with UNSAFE_OFFLINE_ACTION verified in test/security/offline_sync_recovery.test.js.
gateEvidence.userPartitionedOfflineCommandQueue: Client IndexedDB commands are partitioned by actor_user_id and seat_id, sanitized of raw secrets, and support quarantine on session revoke/logout verified in test/security/offline_sync_recovery.test.js.
gateEvidence.authenticatedIdempotentReplayAndMismatch: Server enforces actor active status, replay permission check, exactly-once duplicate outcome caching, and CONFLICT (IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH) on altered payloads verified in test/security/offline_sync_recovery.test.js.
gateEvidence.connectivityStateMachineAndRecovery: Full 6-state connectivity indicator mapping (ONLINE, DEGRADED, OFFLINE, RECONNECTING, STALE, SYNC_ERROR), lost payment UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION state, and gap cursor recovery verified in test/security/offline_sync_recovery.test.js and station_realtime_offline.test.js.
